facts.business: Vishal Fabrics Limited is a textile processing company specializing in denim dyeing, printing, and finishing with over 40 years of industry presence.

auditor.name: S V J K and Associates

key_risks: Global inflation and commodity price volatility
Dependence on cotton supply and pricing
Competition from China and other denim manufacturing hubs
Regulatory and compliance requirements in international markets
facts.related_party_note: Working capital loans secured by personal guarantees of promoters (Mr. Brijmohan D Chiripal, Mr. Ved Prakash Chiripal, Mr. Jyoti Prasad Chiripal, Mr. Jai Prakash Chiripal) and corporate guarantees of M/s Prakash Calender Pvt Ltd and M/s Bhushan Petrofills Pvt Ltd, plus pledge of promoter shares.
